exploding-kitten.name: Exploding Kitten
exploding-kitten.label: Kaboom
exploding-kitten.text: You'll explode unless you have a Defuse to defuse it.

defuse.name: Defuse
defuse.label: Disarm
defuse.text: Neutralizes an Exploding Kitten. Put it back anywhere in the draw pile.

nope.name: Nope
nope.label: Block
nope.text: Stops any action except a Defuse or an Exploding Kitten. Can itself be Noped.

attack-2x.name: Attack 2x
attack-2x.label: Attack
attack-2x.text: Ends your turn without drawing a card. The next player must take 2 turns.

targeted-attack-2x.name: Targeted Attack 2x
targeted-attack-2x.label: Pick a victim
targeted-attack-2x.text: Ends your turn without drawing a card. Choose any player who must take 2 turns.

personal-attack-3x.name: Personal Attack 3x
personal-attack-3x.label: Take 3 turns
personal-attack-3x.text: Ends your current turn without drawing, then take 3 more turns yourself.

skip.name: Skip
skip.label: Skip
skip.text: Ends your turn without drawing a card.

reverse.name: Reverse
reverse.label: Reverse direction
reverse.text: Reverses the play direction and ends your turn without drawing a card.

favor.name: Favor
favor.label: Ask a favor
favor.text: Choose a player; they must pick one card from their hand to give you.

steal-a-card.name: Steal a Card
steal-a-card.label: Steal a card
steal-a-card.text: Choose a player; randomly steal one card from their hand.

draw-from-the-bottom.name: Draw From the Bottom
draw-from-the-bottom.label: Draw from the bottom
draw-from-the-bottom.text: Ends your turn by drawing the card from the bottom of the draw pile.

see-the-future-3x.name: See the Future 3x
see-the-future-3x.label: Peek at 3 cards
see-the-future-3x.text: Secretly look at the top 3 cards of the draw pile.

see-the-future-5x.name: See the Future 5x
see-the-future-5x.label: Peek at 5 cards
see-the-future-5x.text: Secretly look at the top 5 cards of the draw pile.

alter-the-future-3x.name: Alter the Future 3x
alter-the-future-3x.label: Reorder 3 cards
alter-the-future-3x.text: Secretly look at and reorder the top 3 cards of the draw pile.

alter-the-future-5x.name: Alter the Future 5x
alter-the-future-5x.label: Reorder 5 cards
alter-the-future-5x.text: Secretly look at and reorder the top 5 cards of the draw pile.

garbage-collection.name: Garbage Collection
garbage-collection.label: Collect the trash
garbage-collection.text: Every player discards one card into a pile. The pile is shuffled and dealt back out to everyone.

tacocat.name: Tacocat
tacocat.label: Tacocat cat
tacocat.text: Does nothing on its own. Play a matching set of 2, 3, or 5 to form a combo.

cattermelon.name: Cattermelon
cattermelon.label: Cattermelon cat
cattermelon.text: Does nothing on its own. Play a matching set of 2, 3, or 5 to form a combo.

hairy-potato-cat.name: Hairy Potato Cat
hairy-potato-cat.label: Hairy Potato cat
hairy-potato-cat.text: Does nothing on its own. Play a matching set of 2, 3, or 5 to form a combo.

rainbow-ralphing-cat.name: Rainbow Ralphing Cat
rainbow-ralphing-cat.label: Rainbow Ralphing cat
rainbow-ralphing-cat.text: Does nothing on its own. Play a matching set of 2, 3, or 5 to form a combo.

beard-cat.name: Beard Cat
beard-cat.label: Beard cat
beard-cat.text: Does nothing on its own. Play a matching set of 2, 3, or 5 to form a combo.

feral-cat.name: Feral Cat
feral-cat.label: Versatile stray cat
feral-cat.text: Substitutes for any Cat card to complete a combo.
